categories.name: Resolve via payment
categories.description: Resolution of the fine via payment, either timely after issuance or delinquent after notification and penalty.
categories.rationale: Merged timely_payment and delinquent_payment categories per reviewer request, encompassing both direct payments and payments following notification and penalties.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Resolution through administrative appeal steps involving the Prefecture.
categories.rationale: Sample variant V0006 shows execution of appeal steps toward the Prefecture alongside penalty enforcement.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Resolution via an appeal brought before a judge.
categories.rationale: Sample variant V0005 shows fine creation, notification, penalty, and an appeal to the judge.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Resolution through coercive credit collection measures after penalties are applied.
categories.rationale: Sample variant V0002 records fine creation, communication, notification, penalty, and final routing to credit collection.
